description: Working with [Dr. Syed Ishtiaque Ahmed](https://discover.research.utoronto.ca/18628-syed-ishtiaque-ahmed), [Dr. Nusrat Jahan Mim](https://www.nusratmim.net/), and [Dr. S M Taiabul Haque](https://www.bracu.ac.bd/about/people/s-m-taiabul-haque-phd) on how generative AI influences satirical mediation, studied through users' perceptions of a satirical bot. Status: Round 2 of CHI review.

Worked with [Dr. Wolfgang Prinz](https://www.fit.fraunhofer.de/en/wolfgang-prinz.html) on usability and security challenges among novice and experienced crypto wallet users in Bangladesh. Accepted at CHIRA 2026.

org: National University of Singapore & Penn State
description: Working with [Dr. Tanusree Sharma](https://ist.psu.edu/directory/tfs5747) at Penn State and collaborating with [Dr. Collins Munyendo](https://collinsmunyendo.github.io/) at NUS on age verification in the Global South, with attention to user comprehension and attitudes toward privacy and security.
